assets.name: card-normal
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied blank UI asset. Change ONLY its gold metal rounded rectangular rim to neutral polished SILVER / platinum, charcoal bevel shadows and white highlights. No yellow or gold in the rim. Preserve exactly the silhouette and aspect ratio 254:280, rim position/thickness, wooden brown filling, its grain and brightness, glossy bright GREEN leaves, orange mushrooms, all decorations and their positions. Everything except the metal rim must remain identical. No text, no labels, no icons, no extra sparkles, no new decorations. Preserve genuine transparent exterior, crop close with minimal transparent padding, entire frame visible, front orthographic view. This is a color variant of an existing production game UI asset, not a redesign.
